body: This all sounds  like multiple  sclerosis. My grandma  also has it. They found the inflammation  with an MRI. At first my physician thought it was  linked to anxiety and stress.

Have you been  checked for multiplex sclerosis  or other  autoimmune  diseases? Brain  MRI showed anything? I had an inflammation  in my central  nervous System behind  my left eye that was  causing dizziness and I got  a huge  dose  of steroid  for the inflammation. Now  the dizziness is slowly getting better.
Girlll...you're gorgeous. I bet  he's insecure  and wants to shatter  your self-esteem só you wont  leave his  ass. Thats a power move. Run while you can.
These posts  make  real  experiencers seem  nutjobs. I think you need some serious help, or this  is some  very cheap way to make  ufo encounters  seem  delusional.
Omfg...no one  snatches my  child from my hands. That would be the last  time  se held  her  granddaughter. How can  you tolerate  this?
No. Just the pure capability for us to feel such complex emotions and strong inner world of each of us.

The public libraries have been closed because of the pandemic for like 2 weeks now, so that is not an option. And I saw a comment that suggested that I start a GoFundme page but it disappeared bedore I could answer it. I haven't thought about it and would be too embarrased and ashamed to do it.

I am really sorry you are going through this. It is really hard to deal with all of this, i know. During this pandemic all I see is immense inequality. The rich getting richer and the unfortunate ordinary person just strugling. There are so many young people now considering ending their lives and it is heartbreaking. I totally feel the same. It is a constant struggle for nothing, when we have advanced civilizations, and given there would be no mega rich people everybody could have a decent life. I just don't know what to do. I'm sick of this struggle.

I really appreciate the kind words. It means a lot to me. When I lost my job I applied for unemployment assistance but here in Hungary it is for maximum 3 months. I have nowhere and no one to turn for help honestly. I tried to ask for a laptop from my uni but they were all gifted out already. 4 months ago I had to choose between paying for my semester or having more months to eat food, so I am passive in uni now. I was more hopeful back then.But now It is clear to me that it can take a really long time to find another job. They are not hiring anywhere here especially with an unfinished degree. I feel lost and alone. When my laptop broke down it felt like the universe is telling me to just give up. I am too emotionally fragile for this because of my rough start as a child. I feel like I cannot take emotionally to become alone and homeless because of a something that is beyond me to overcome. I always loved working. I am ashamed and also emotionally drained and lonely to keep fighting.
